posts.cooked:
As we know, there are many artists working on Spirit Island, and many of them have released some of their artwork for the game. Since they all prefer different platforms, it's a little hard to track it all down. I'm going to compile a list of the pieces I find here.

The artists, as listed at the end of the Kickstarter video, are

  • Jason Behnke
  • Loic Belliau
  • Rocky Hammer
  • Sydni Kruger
  • Nolan Nasser
  • Jorge Ramos
  • Moro Rogers
  • Graham Sternberg (misspelled in the credits)
  • Shane Tyree
  • Joshua Wright

Adam Rebottaro is also credited for Art Design, but I don't know that he did any of the principal illustrations himself. In addition, I found one artist so far who appears to have done some work but isn't (yet) credited:

  • Beth Zyglowicz, SpaceTurtleStudios

Here's a list I will update with released illustrations by each artist:

Rocky Hammer
https://www.behance.net/gallery/29788809/Spirit-Island-Lightnings-Swift-Strike
http://rockyhammer.com/

Principal design for Lightning’s Swift Strike. Public illustrations include

  • Lightning’s Swift Strike character art
  • Lightning’s Boon, unique power, aiding River Surges in Sunlight
  • Shatter Homesteads, unique power
  • Raging Storm, unique power
  • Another illustration at BGG: https://boardgamegeek.com/image/2537472/spirit-island

Amusingly, this is three out of the four unique powers, and the fourth one (Harbingers of the Lightning) is carefully hidden in the shot of Lightning's unique powers in the KS video (at 1:28). I guess it's not ready for release yet.. EDIT: But it's in the video at 3:27, as revealed on Kickstarter update #7.

Sydni Kruger
http://sydnikruger.com/

Principal design for Vital Strength of Earth.

  • Character panel: http://sydnikruger.com/portfolio-2/characters-and-people/characterpanelfinal-2/
  • A Year of Perfect Stillness. http://sydnikruger.com/portfolio-2/illustration-portfolio/peacefulfinal/
  • Guard the Healing Land. Found by google-hacking. http://sydnikruger.com/portfolio-2/illustration-portfolio/protectfinal/

Nolan N. Nasser
http://www.n3art.com/
https://www.facebook.com/nolannasser
https://twitter.com/Nolan_N_Nasser

Appears to have done a lot, including principal design for River Surges in Sunlight. I'm guessing on the correspondence between illustration and card, feel free to post other guesses.

  • River Surges in Sunlight, Boon of Vigor, Wash Away, Flash Floods: https://twitter.com/Nolan_N_Nasser/status/646364702482763776
  • Above, plus River’s Bounty: https://www.facebook.com/nolannasser/posts/10207576811955568
  • Drought, Gift of Living Energy, Voracious Growth, Tsunami: https://twitter.com/Nolan_N_Nasser/status/646420785670823936
  • Four more illustrations, one with Mists Carry a Silent Fate: https://twitter.com/Nolan_N_Nasser/status/646711266552213504
  • Heart of the Wildfire, and apparently three of its power cards: https://twitter.com/Nolan_N_Nasser/status/648511396003622912/photo/1

Jorge Ramos
http://www.joremdesign.com/

  • A Pillar of Living Flame: http://www.joremdesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/001_Pillar_Living_Flame.jpg
  • Pact of the Joined Hunt: http://www.joremdesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/002_Pact_Joined_Hunt_byJorem.jpg
  • Gift of the Dreaming Deeps: http://www.joremdesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/Gift_Dreaming_Deeps_byJoremWEB.jpg
  • Land of Haunts and Embers: http://www.joremdesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/005_Land_Haunts_Embers_byJorem.jpg
  • Bloodwrack Plague: http://www.joremdesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/001_bloodwrack_plaga_byJorem.jpg

Moro Rogers
http://mrogersportfolio.blogspot.com/2010/12/blog-post.html

  • An animal spirit, appearing at 0:18 in the Kickstarter video: http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-xjpTtfR0k2Y/Vbf_D2HQ0VI/AAAAAAAABrI/0HdTPDGDzvI/s1600/fangswithbgcolor01.jpg
  • But who is this? http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-HNwNaKk4mLA/U3aL1V5FW-I/AAAAAAAABiU/VlwmNgqhVng/s1600/elementalspirit01.jpg

Graham Sternberg
https://www.behance.net/gallery/23524155/Spirit-Island
http://www.grahamsternberg.com/

  • "Call to Migrate", Minor Power: http://www.grahamsternberg.com/uploads/3/0/3/1/30317377/2486537_orig.jpg
  • "The Trees and Stones Speak of War", Major Power: http://www.grahamsternberg.com/uploads/3/0/3/1/30317377/5440835_orig.jpg

Shane Tyree
http://www.shane-tyree.com/portfolio/index.php

No publically identified art, although I'm reminded of the style of Bringers of Dreams and Nightmares.

Joshua Wright
Appears to be http://www.heliocentric.com.au/

  • Keeper of the Forbidden Wilds: https://boardgamegeek.com/image/2537471/spirit-island

Beth Zyglowicz (Space Turtle Studios)
http://spaceturtlestudios.deviantart.com/gallery/
http://spaceturtlestudios.tumblr.com/post/129645750217/today-is-the-launch-of-the-spirit-island-board

Designed Mists Carry a Silent Fate.

  • Mists Carry a Silent Fate: http://spaceturtlestudios.deviantart.com/art/Spirit-Island-Mists-Carry-a-Silent-Fate-561853144
  • Incapacitating Ailments: http://spaceturtlestudios.deviantart.com/art/Spirit-Island-Incapacitating-Ailments-561853740
  • Presistent Dissolving: http://spaceturtlestudios.deviantart.com/art/Spirit-Island-Persistent-Dissolving-561854141
  • Strangling Tendrils: http://spaceturtlestudios.deviantart.com/art/Spirit-Island-Strangling-Tendrils-561854403

posts.cooked: By the way, welcome, Bunston! I haven't noticed you much on the boards before. Did you just print out the PnP? How many games have you played?
posts.raw: By the way, welcome, Bunston! I haven't noticed you much on the boards before. Did you just print out the PnP? How many games have you played?

posts.name: Bunston
posts.cooked: Ya, I found the PnP. I've played 6 games so far, one with each Spirit and then 2 more with Vital Strength of the Earth. I have to wait to play it with other people for a couple of weeks unfortunately, but the solo games have been quite fun. I really like how this game actually has a solo play option (I'm looking at you Sentinels), and each Spirit feels unique and interesting. I'm really looking forward to seeing the rest of the Spirit boards and their unique powers. I'm a sucker for co-op games (video or board) where each player has unique strengths and weaknesses they bring to the team.

posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked: How did you find the difficulty level? Did you use the Adversary and/or Scenario included in the PnP rulebook?
posts.raw: How did you find the difficulty level? Did you use the Adversary and/or Scenario included in the PnP rulebook?

posts.name: Bunston
posts.cooked:
I haven’t played the adversary or the scenario yet, I'd probably play those when I finally get a group together. I find the earth and lightning spirits are easier than the shadow and water spirits, but as of now I only have one play on three of them, so I hardly have a good sample size.

 

I do really appreciate how your unique cards and innate power can smooth out unfavorable power draws. You are guaranteed to have at least the basic tools you need at all times.

posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked:
I went through the Kickstarter video, looking for all the art pieces I could find. There are several questionable identifications; let me know if you have suggestions!

[list]
[*] 0:08: Panoramic view of a valley.
[*] 0:12: Volcanic Eruption (major power)
[*] 0:16: Massive storm on the coast. Could be Tsunami, although there was another candidate for that.
[*] 0:18: The animal spirit "behind the leaves" drawn by Moro Rogers
[*] 0:20: Serpent Slumbering Beneath the Island
[*] 0:23: Perhaps Dark and Tangled Woods, given the narration
[*] 0:25: River Surges in Sunlight with a Dahan spirit-speaker. Not drawn by Nolan Nasser, so not one of the Unique Powers. Maybe one of the Calls (Isolation, etc)?
[*] 0:29: Tidal Boon, Ocean's Unique power, also in Kickstarter Update #7
[*] 0:31: Guard the Healing Land? Artist: Sydni Kruger
[*] 0:33: Call to Migrate, Graham Sternberg
[*] 0:36: Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares. Looks to be a Unique Power, which have not been revealed yet.
[*] 0:38: Pull Beneath the Hungry Earth?
[*] 0:41: Vital Strength of Earth, looking a little different from its other art. One spirit helping another, in any case.
[*] 0:44: Raging Storm of Lightning’s Swift Strike, by Rocky Hammer
[*] 0:50: Pact of the Joined Hunt, by Jorge Ramos, featuring the animal spirit from 0:18.
[*] 0:52: The Trees and Stones Speak of War, Graham Sternberg
[*] 0:56: Moons over the island. Not sure what this is representing.
[*] 0:59: Invaders on the shores. This is the back of the Stage 1 Invader deck.
[*] 1:03: Invaders lost in the mists.
[*] 1:07: Conquistadors fighting growth in a jungle. Several possibilities here.
[*] 1:10: More invaders in the darkness.
[*] 1:12: What I guessed to be Drought, by Nolan Nasser
[*] 1:15: Land of Haunts and Embers, by Jorge Ramos
[*] 1:18: Rouse the Trees and Stones?
[*] 1:39: A shot of Draw of the Fruitful Earth and Rituals of Destruction, which I haven't seen otherwise.
[*] 3:07: Thunderspeaker’s main art
[*] 3:15: Dahan being blessed, perhaps by Thunderspeaker (although, if so, in what appears to be a male form)
[*] 3:17: Ghostly Dahan attacking at night. Veil the Night’s Hunt?
[*] 3:20: This was my guess for Tsunami, by Nolan Nasser
[*] 3:23: Homesteads on fire. Visions of Fiery Doom?
[*] 3:24: Vital Strength of Earth flying, which presumably involves cooperation between two spirits.
[*] 3:27: Harbingers of Lightning, unique power for Lightning's Swift Strike
[*] 3:31: Ghosts chasing off invaders. Delusions of Danger?
[*] 3:33: Ocean's Hungry Grasp
[*] 3:36: Lightning’s Swift Strike and Vital Strength of Earth, doing something together.
[/list]

posts.cooked:
I guess the spirits are meant to be neither good nor bad, they just want to protect their lands (and in fact HAVE to if they don't want to be destroyed themselves) so they are using any means at their disposal to rid themselves of the invaders.

Let's not forget they aren't human, or even close. It's like us using bug spray to exterminate insects - dangerous insects that are going to take over our house and kill us if we don't stop them.
